bullets.text: TikTok US Sale Finalized - **TikTok** agrees to divest its US operations to American investors, ending a long regulatory battle.
NHS Data Breach Confirmed - **DXS International** reports a cyberattack affecting its services for **NHS England**.
British Politicians Join US Tech - Former UK finance minister **George Osborne** joins **OpenAI** amid a trend of UK politicians moving to US tech firms.
ChatGPT Launches App Store - **OpenAI** opens its chatbot to developers, allowing app submissions for enhanced user capabilities.
Apple's New Developer Agreement - **Apple** updates its developer terms, allowing it to collect unpaid fees from in-app purchases.
Amazon Enhances Ring Doorbells - **Amazon** adds conversational AI to **Ring** doorbells, improving user interaction with visitors.
LinkedIn Profile Verification Grows - **LinkedIn** sees a surge in profile verifications, particularly in India, enhancing user authenticity.
Rivian's Hands-Free Driving - **Rivian** introduces a new hands-free driving feature, expanding its autonomous capabilities.
Instacart Settles FTC Claims - **Instacart** agrees to pay $60M to settle allegations of misleading advertising practices.
EtherealX Secures Funding - Indian startup **EtherealX** raises $21M for its reusable launch vehicle project, targeting SpaceX competition.
